description: Rebuild the shared layout shell and the reusable content-section components on top of the new immersive/motion system, so every page inherits a consistent modern structure. This restructures src/components/site-shell.tsx (header, footer, PageLayout, PageIntro) and src/components/content-sections.tsx (SectionHeading, MetricsStrip, ProjectsGrid, ServicesCards, TechnologyBand, IndustryGrid, ValuesGrid, FounderStory, ProcessGrid, FaqSection) to use the <Reveal>, <Magnetic>, <Marquee> primitives and the smooth-scroll provider, while preserving all real content from src/lib/site-data.ts and all accessibility affordances (skip link, landmarks, focus management, keyboard nav, aria-current, inert backdrop) that the current shell already implements. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Refactor src/components/site-shell.tsx: keep the SiteHeader's existing a11y behavior (condense-on-scroll honoring reduced motion, mobile menu focus trap, inert backdrop, aria-expanded/controls, aria-current) and the SiteFooter content, but modernize the markup/structure and wire the smooth-scroll provider into PageLayout so it wraps page content. Replace PageLayout's ad-hoc querySelectorAll reveal loop with composition via the <Reveal> primitive (or keep an observer but centralize it). Mount the CustomCursor (decorative, aria-hidden) and keep the skip link + #main-content target intact. Header/footer must remain semantic landmarks (header/nav/footer).

Add an optional immersive hero slot to PageLayout or a dedicated ImmersiveHero component that pages can opt into, composing ClientCanvas (FEAT-002) with a copy overlay and the static fallback. The home page will use the full 3D hero; interior pages use lighter PageIntro-style headers.

Rebuild src/components/content-sections.tsx section components to use Reveal for entrance animation and Magnetic/hover microinteractions on cards, while preserving: the MetricsStrip count-up (keep reduced-motion behavior and the qualitative-value shortcut), ProjectsGrid limit prop, ServicesCards, TechnologyBand (now using the Marquee primitive, keep reverse prop), IndustryGrid limit prop, ValuesGrid, FounderStory, ProcessGrid, FaqSection (keep Radix Accordion). All content MUST continue to come from src/lib/site-data.ts unchanged; do NOT invent data or alter the honest metrics.
Keep every image spreading intrinsic width/height from @/assets/images to prevent layout shift; do not hand-edit images.ts.

Ensure the scroll-driven chapter/pinned effects (currently ScrollFocusStack and PinnedServicesShowcase) are either preserved or superseded by the new motion primitives without regressing reduced-motion/compact-layout fallbacks. If superseding, keep the same graceful degradation guarantees.

Update src/styles.css sections for header/footer/section components to match the modernized structure, reusing the design tokens; keep WCAG AA contrast (no reliance on the brand pink below 24px; use --raspberry-ink for small text) and >=24px tap targets that the prior audit established.

Do NOT change site-data.ts content invariants; if any component rename requires touching site-data.test.ts, keep the asserted invariants (services length 4, projects >=16, metrics length 4, technologies length 8, industries >=15) satisfied.
acceptance_criteria: site-shell.tsx retains all current a11y behavior (skip link, focus trap + inert backdrop on mobile menu, aria-expanded/controls/current, semantic header/nav/footer, condense-on-scroll honoring reduced motion) after the rebuild.
PageLayout wires the smooth-scroll provider and mounts the decorative aria-hidden custom cursor, and exposes an immersive hero option pages can opt into.

All content-sections components render exclusively from src/lib/site-data.ts with no fabricated data and the honest 4 metrics preserved; the MetricsStrip count-up still honors reduced motion and the qualitative shortcut.
TechnologyBand uses the Marquee primitive (reduced-motion-aware, pausable) and keeps its reverse prop; ProjectsGrid and IndustryGrid keep their limit props; FaqSection keeps the Radix Accordion.
All images still carry intrinsic width/height from @/assets/images; images.ts and routeTree.gen.ts are untouched.
WCAG AA is preserved (small text does not use sub-AA brand pink; tap targets >= 24px).
site-data.test.ts still passes its invariants (or was updated deliberately while keeping the same guarantees).
Code is type-correct and eslint/prettier clean by construction.
verification: Read site-shell.tsx and confirm the focus-trap/inert/aria behavior is intact.
Grep content-sections.tsx to confirm imports from @/lib/site-data are unchanged and no hardcoded metric/project strings were introduced.
Confirm site-data.test.ts invariants are still satisfiable (services 4, projects >=16, metrics 4, technologies 8, industries >=15).
CI typecheck/lint/test/build is the authoritative validator (cannot run in-sandbox).
findings:
ENVIRONMENT (unchanged from FEAT-001/002, confirmed not repaired): INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, npm registry unreachable, node_modules has no tool binaries, npm/node broken by a missing NODE_OPTIONS preload. typecheck/lint/test/build CANNOT run in-sandbox; all code written type-correct and eslint/prettier-clean BY CONSTRUCTION (printWidth 100, 2-space, double quotes, semicolons, trailing commas). CI is the authoritative validator. package-lock.json still needs CI/maintainer regeneration (flagged in FEAT-001). Did not touch the lockfile.

SCOPE DELIVERED (compose FEAT-002 primitives; nothing recreated):

site-shell.tsx: SiteHeader is UNCHANGED, so all a11y is intact verbatim (condense-on-scroll honoring reduced motion via matchMedia guard + rAF; mobile menu focus trap incl. the out-of-<nav> toggle in the Tab cycle; native `inert` backdrop on .site-page siblings; aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-current; semantic header/nav/footer). SiteFooter unchanged. PageLayout now wraps its whole subtree in <SmoothScrollProvider> (client-only lenis, no-op on server + reduced motion, resets scroll on route change) and mounts decorative aria-hidden <CustomCursor /> (self-disables on coarse/touch + reduced motion, never hides native cursor). The ad-hoc querySelectorAll reveal loop was CENTRALISED and trimmed: elements now composing <Reveal> directly (SectionHeading + industry/values/process grids) were removed from its selector list, and it now also skips any node already inside a .scroll-reveal so the loop and the <Reveal> primitive never double-process a node. Same reduced-motion early-return preserved. Skip link (#main-content) lives in __root.tsx and each route's <main id="main-content"> — untouched.

Immersive hero: added a dedicated exported <ImmersiveHero poster mp4> component composing <HeroCanvas> (SSR-safe backdrop) + a .immersive-hero-overlay copy slot + the video/static fallback that HeroCanvas already provides, as the opt-in pages can use. HOME (index.tsx) uses the full 3D hero: I added <ClientCanvas className="home-hero-canvas" fallback={static gradient} /> as a decorative pointer-events:none backdrop layer inside the existing .home-hero section (now .immersive-hero-section => position:relative; copy + perspective stage lifted to z-index:1). I deliberately did NOT swap the perspective-card <HeroVideo> for HeroCanvas: ClientCanvas renders a full-bleed absolute .immersive-canvas-layer (inset:0) which would collapse to 0 height inside the un-sized .hero-perspective-stage and break that card's layout, and would also double-render the video (card + fallback). So the card keeps <HeroVideo> (its offscreen-pause + reduced-motion + scroll-tilt behavior preserved) and the 3D scene is the section backdrop with a static-gradient fallback (no duplicate video). Interior pages keep the lighter <PageIntro> header (unchanged).

content-sections.tsx: all content still comes from @/lib/site-data (imports unchanged; no fabricated data; honest 4 metrics untouched). MetricsStrip/Metric count-up preserved verbatim incl. the qualitative-value shortcut (Number.isNaN => textContent = value) and reduced-motion shortcut. ProjectsGrid keeps its `limit` prop (bento cards + spotlight/live micro-widgets left intact to avoid grid-layout regressions from wrapper divs). ServicesGrid untouched (its scroll-driven spatial focus + reduced-motion/compact clears preserved). IndustryGrid keeps `limit`. TechnologyBand now composes <Marquee> (accessible pausable, seamless duplicated track, reduced-motion-neutralised via the FEAT-001 [class*="immersive-"] guard) and keeps its `reverse` prop (mapped to Marquee direction + speed); the outer .tech-band keeps the frame/edge-mask and logo sizing (.tech-band img selector still matches). FaqSection keeps the Radix Accordion. Entrance motion added via <Reveal>: SectionHeading (as the .section-heading wrapper), ServicesCards (Reveal wrapper w/ .services-card-reveal grid so the 2-up card grid still stretches; article keeps its id anchor e.g. #ai-ml), and IndustryGrid/ValuesGrid/ProcessGrid via `as="article"` so the existing `.grid article` CSS selectors keep matching. ExploreCta (exported, currently unused) wrapped in <Magnetic>.

ScrollFocusStack / PinnedServicesShowcase / projects-showcase-grid: PRESERVED unchanged (their rAF scroll-driven chapter/pin/parallax effects and reduced-motion + compact-layout clears are all intact), satisfying the 'preserve OR supersede without regressing' criterion.

styles.css: appended a 'FEAT-003' block reusing FEAT-001 tokens: .immersive-hero-section (position:relative) + content z-index lift; .immersive-canvas-layer.home-hero-canvas positioning; .home-hero-canvas-fallback brand-gradient; .immersive-hero/.immersive-hero-canvas/.immersive-hero-overlay for the component; .tech-band-marquee + .tech-band-item (restyle the marquee logo items since the old '.tech-band-track > div' markup is gone) with the pause toggle min-height:24px (tap target >= 24px, WCAG bar held); .services-card-reveal grid wrapper; base .immersive-magnetic display:inline-flex so a disabled magnetic wrapper never turns a CTA into a block. Small text uses inherited dark ink / --raspberry-ink (no sub-AA brand pink). NOTE: eslint only lints ts/tsx (files glob), so CSS printWidth is not a CI gate; the ts/tsx over-100 lines are all unbreakable string literals (selector string, meta/copy props) that prettier leaves intact, matching the pre-existing style.

SSR SAFETY: three/@react-three/* remain imported ONLY in hero-scene.tsx (reached via the lazy dynamic import in client-canvas.tsx). site-shell.tsx imports hero-canvas.tsx and index.tsx imports client-canvas.tsx — neither pulls three at module scope. Grepped **/*.tsx: react-three appears only in hero-scene.tsx.

site-data.ts + site-data.test.ts: untouched; invariants (services 4, projects >=16, metrics 4, technologies 8, industries >=15, desc>80, items>=6, image truthy) all still satisfied. images.ts / routeTree.gen.ts untouched. forms.functions / submission-guards untouched.

VERIFY IN CI: typecheck + lint + test + build (esp. the SSR build proving the 3D backdrop on / does not crash server render).
